name: com.melenitasdev.sounds-good
displayName: Sounds Good Lite - Easy & Optimized Audio Manager
description:
The easiest and quickest way to implement audio into your game - An optimized and user-friendly system for all skill levels ;D 

This is the Lite edition of Sounds Good. It covers sounds, music, playlists and multiple audio channels, with the same one-line API and the same editor windows to manage them. Implement audio with a single line of code, or without code at all using the Sound, Music and Playlist emitters.
